info.title: Salon Staff API
info.description: Errors use RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` and a `hint`. Sign in through `/v1/auth/*` (Better Auth); the website uses a cookie, the mobile app `Authorization: Bearer <session token>`. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header with a `POST` to make it safe to retry. Add `?dry_run=true` to a change to validate it without applying it.

email.description: Null for an account made with a mobile number and no email yet.

salon.description: The salon you manage, if any.

level.description: 0 not verified, 1 ID verified, 2 work-ready (ID and right to work).

get.description: Where to find the documentation and the machine-readable description of this API.
Your account, your job seeker profile (if you've made one), your verification summary with the verification IDs of passed checks, and the salon you manage (if any).

delete.description: Permanently deletes your account, profile, pictures, applications and checks, and signs you out everywhere. A salon you created is deleted with its jobs; a directory listing you claimed goes back to being unclaimed. This can't be undone.

get.description: Everything salons see when you apply: basics, skills and availability, experience, education, portfolio and verification.

put.description: Creates your job seeker profile, or replaces its basics. Your account's name becomes `firstName lastName`. The mobile number may be in any Australian format; it's stored as +614….

Specialties and brands (tags; duplicates are dropped, ignoring case), the days and kinds of work you're after, when you can start, how far you'll travel and your pay expectation. Needs a profile first.

post.description: Returns a `url` to send the person to: Stripe Identity's pages (a government ID and a live selfie), or locally a mock page. Afterwards they come back to `returnUrl` (default: the website's /account/verify; the mobile app passes `salonstaff://verify-complete`). The result arrives by webhook: re-read GET /v1/me/checks. Needs a profile first, so the name on the ID can be compared with it.

post.summary: Send your right to work for checking
post.description: Staff check it (VEVO for a visa, so a visa needs its grant number). The grant number and passport country are deleted as soon as it's decided; only the basis and how it was checked are kept.

post.description: A certificate (`file`: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, 8MB at most) and the qualification's `title`, e.g. Cert III in Hairdressing. The certificate is kept privately only until staff decide, then deleted.

409.description: A qualification is already waiting for review

get.description: Live jobs, featured first, then the nearest (when searching near a point), then the newest, 20 a page. Each has its public `path`. `q` matches the title, suburb, postcode, salon name and description. `suburb` is a suburb's slug (`surry-hills`). Near me: `lat` and `lng` (or `near` with a postcode) and `km`; jobs are placed at their suburb's centre.

get.description: What the website shows at a `/jobs/...` address (D-07). `kind: landing` is a role and/or place listing (`/jobs/hairdresser/nsw/surry-hills`) with its live jobs, `noindex` when there are none. `kind: job` is a job ad; a closed or expired one still answers, with `closed: true` and up to 5 similar live jobs. `kind: redirect` means the ad or salon was renamed or moved: answer with a 301 to `redirect`. Anything else is a 404.

post.description: Needs a profile and a verified identity (and a verified qualification if the job asks for one). Up to 20 applications a day. The salon is told straight away; they see your full profile and contact details.

404.description: No live job with that ID

post.description: Keeps it in GET /v1/me/saved. Saving twice is fine.

404.description: No live job with that ID

post.description: Onboarding. The ABN is checksum-checked, then looked up on the Australian Business Register. If the business is already in the directory (an unclaimed listing with that ABN), claim it instead: the 409's `hint` names its claim page. New salons list jobs free for 90 days, and the first 200 keep founding pricing. Your account becomes an employer account.

409.description: You already manage a salon, or the business's listing should be claimed

get.description: Its details, public `path`, launch terms and whether it can publish a job now (`entitlement`).

patch.description: Send only what changes; a blank or null website, Instagram or about clears it. A new name, suburb or state gives the salon (and its jobs) a new address; the old ones redirect. A new ABN is checked again.

get.description: Newest first, drafts included, with how many people applied and how many are new.

post.description: Saved as a draft, or published for 30 days with `publish: true`. Publishing uses the free period, then the Salon Plan, then a listing credit; with none of those it's refused (`listing_needed`) and nothing is saved.

402.description: A listing credit or the Salon Plan is needed to publish

patch.description: Send only what changes. A new title, suburb or state gives a published ad a new address; the old one redirects.

post.description: Live for 30 days from now. Uses the free period, then the Salon Plan, then a listing credit (taken in the same step). A job that's already live is left alone and nothing is charged.

402.description: A listing credit or the Salon Plan is needed

Near me: `lat` and `lng` (or `near` with a postcode) and `km`; salons are placed at their suburb's centre.

get.description: What the website shows at a `/salons/...` address (D-07): the directory for a state or suburb (`kind: landing`), a salon's page with its live jobs (`kind: salon`; contact details only for signed-in visitors), or `kind: redirect` for a renamed or moved salon (answer with a 301). Anything else is a 404.

post.description: The ABN must match the listing's (or, when it has none, be active on the Australian Business Register). Then prove you run the business: with `method: email` we send a link to the listing's own email (it lasts 48 hours; `sentTo` shows where, masked), and opening it while signed in as you completes the claim. Without a listing email, or with `method: review`, staff check it. An approved claim makes the listing yours, with the free period and founding pricing of a new salon.

409.description: Already claimed, the ABN doesn't match, or you already manage a salon

post.summary: Confirm a claim from its emailed link
post.description: Sign in as the person who started the claim first. Completes the claim: the listing becomes your salon and your account an employer account.

409.description: In conflict with the current state

post.summary: Ask staff to check a claim instead
post.description: For when the listing's email can't be reached. The emailed link stops working.

get.description: Your most recent claim on it, whatever its status.

404.description: No claim, or no such salon

get.description: Whether you can publish now and how (free period, Salon Plan or credits), your prices, plan, and recent payments.

post.summary: Buy a listing or start the Salon Plan
post.description: Returns a checkout `url` (Stripe Checkout; locally a mock page). A single listing ($49, GST included) adds one credit that publishes a job for 30 days. The Salon Plan is monthly with unlimited listings. What you bought arrives once the payment is confirmed.

404.description: No salon yet, or billing is off

post.description: Returns a Stripe billing portal `url`: change or cancel the Salon Plan, see invoices.

404.description: No salon yet, or billing is off

post.description: Checkout payments, subscription changes and Stripe Identity results, signed with the webhook secret (`Stripe-Signature`). For Stripe only.

get.description: Every live job ad, every visible salon page, and every listing page that has something on it: jobs by role and place (`/jobs/{role}/{state}/{suburb}` and everything above it) and the directory by place. Closed jobs and empty listings are left out.
